title: GPOM Chorus: the sky, then the silence
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ the chorus: the sky, then the silence
moodboard_intro: Round 1. The one half-chorus (about 11 s) between the banks and the war. The world's busiest places, three ways each: full of people, the people looking up at the sky, and the same frame empty. Plus four looks for the lights in the sky and two close-ups of faces. Tap This, Maybe or No; leave a note per beat.
storyboard_intro: Frames in order: the sky (beats 1-16), the cut, the silence (beats 17-32).

beats.name: What's in the sky
beats.blurb: Four looks for the lights over the cities. The autonomous army arriving, seen only as light.

beats.name: A football stadium
beats.blurb: Full, looking up, empty: the floodlights still on.

beats.name: A motorway interchange
beats.blurb: Full, looking up, empty: every car left where it stopped.

beats.name: Faces
beats.blurb: Close on people looking up, lit from above. Awe and fear, never pain.
